display_long_description:
**🚧 Wall Trace is currently in active development!** 
　
We’re working to make the Mixed Reality wall-drawing experience even more enjoyable and inspiring. Your support, ideas, and feedback help us shape the future of Wall Trace. Please share your comments, impressions, and features you would love to see—we’re looking forward to hearing from you! 🎨✨　

[media]


**Transform Your Room into an Art Studio!** 🖌️✨

Ever wanted to create beautiful wall art with ease? Wall Trace uses Mixed Reality to project images directly onto your physical walls. Simply trace the glowing lines, focus on your strokes, and watch your artwork come to life!


### ・**CHOOSE YOUR IMAGE**

Start with one of the included designs or choose an image stored on your Quest.

### ・**PLACE IT ON YOUR WALL**

Position, resize, and rotate your reference until it fits your space.

[media]


### ・**TRACING EASIER**

Adjust the opacity while you work. For supported images, simplify the reference by removing the background and changing the line color for clearer outlines.

[media]


### ・**DRAW IT FOR REAL**

Pick up your pencil, marker, or brush and trace the reference directly onto the physical surface.

[media]


### ・**KEEP YOUR PLACE**

Save your placement and return to your project later without starting over.

The image is displayed through your Quest headset—the artwork is created by you, on the real wall.

From a small sketch to your next mural, Wall Trace gives you a simple way to move a design from screen to surface.
